Invest #92W is east of Luzon, drifting toward Central Philippines with little thunderstorm activity for now. But it may bring heavy rain (2–4") through Wednesday.

⚠️ Flooding possible in low-lying and urban areas. Landslides in mountain zones. Development into a tropical cyclone is still unlikely in the next 24 hours, but the system may strengthen once it reaches the South China Sea.
